scope: Explicit selected local COMMON material renderpass states, not lighting
source: Actual lizardman.bdae local COMMON effect selected default technique, decoded using existing effect_render_pass_v4 richpass kernel
changes: Material optional SourceMaterialPass is authoritative over atlas-alpha and vertex-alpha inference.
Renderer uses actual source blend factors, depth test/write/function, cull/frontface and source ALPHATEST admission.
Source opaque diffuse remains opaque with depth writes even on alpha-containing atlases.
Actual COMMON additive uses ONE/ONE; alpha uses SRC_ALPHA/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA.
CharacterVisual resolves actual instance material ID to local COMMON selected technique; records selected metadata technique and preserves pose/cache code.
Unknown external GLES/material families retain prior fallback.
Fallback draws and new frame reset depth/cull/winding/alpha/blend state to prevent source-pass leakage.

Exact selected COMMON shader/preamble classified CommonUnlit disables generic GL lighting independent of Color0 presence. Conditional/unknown and known-lit variants retain existing fallback; no light evaluation added.

api.selected_technique: Native default technique index0 unless declared serialized type20 override resolves actual existing technique

integration: Root registered module/kernels and native test in CMake. Production package re-render and complete suite remain root integration checks.

Source pass states do not establish complete shader/fog/light/material fidelity or video parity.
